question: The Kuiper Belt is a ring of icy rocks & dust bodies just outside the orbit of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neptune.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kuiper Belt **is a region in the **outer solar system **beyond the orbit of **Neptune, **consisting of small icy objects like **comets and dwarf planets.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saturn **is located in the** inner solar system**, between Jupiter and Uranus, and does not have any significant icy asteroid belt beyond its orbit.
 
• **Venus** is an inner planet,** closer to the Sun than Earth,** and has no known asteroid belt or Kuiper Belt objects in its vicinity.
 
• **Jupiter** is the **largest planet in the solar system** and has its own set of **Trojan asteroids** in its orbit, but it is not located beyond Neptune where the Kuiper Belt exists.
 
• **Neptune** is the eighth planet from the Sun and is known to have a **well-defined Kuiper Belt region** that extends from about **30 AU to 50 AU** from the Sun.
